acceptanceCriteria: A defect can be referenced from a ticket and an expected-fail annotation; a reference to an unknown or not-a-bug id is a preflight finding.
An environment-category defect does not satisfy a blocked-by-defect obligation.
Updates are append-only and safe under concurrency.
The register can be excluded from published or backed-up artefacts by configuration.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1036 (opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Problem Agents find product faults while writing tests but must not fix product code under their ticket. Findings end up scattered in notes, and a blocked obligation cannot distinguish a real product defect from a fixable environment fault. Current workaround An append-only, locked JSONL ledger of defects (id, location, evidence reference, severity, status suspected/confirmed/not-a-bug/duplicate-of, category product or environment), where later lines override earlier ones, plus a rendered summary and a harvest of untriaged mentions from notes. Audits refuse an environment defect as the reason an obligation is blocked. Proposal `corvint defects add|update|list|harvest`, referenceable from obligations and expected-fail annotations. See beamfall/corvint#1036 for the full text.
title: defects: register for suspected product and environment faults found during test work (issue #1036)
